The following works in OLDA^K (Macsyma created in LISP 1914) but does the 
following in A^K (Essentially the same Macsyma created in LISP 1997):

LOADFILE(IMSL,FASL,SHARE2); CRANK(1,7); quits to DDT with 
MPV;11710>>HLRZM 7,(7) after < 30 secs.

has been fixed in the current LISP and hence in the current MACSYMA 
by RWK.
